consultation_summary_text: W-A15b read robots.txt on the legacy safco.com.sa document host and current www.sabic-agrinutrients.com host; both returned an empty Disallow directive. The legacy landing and current reports page returned HTTP 200 and linked their respective legal-disclaimer pages, which were each read once. The visible terms state that entering, browsing, downloading or copying site material is subject to those terms; no numeric request-rate policy was identified within the consultation. The bounded Board Report URL below is an official legacy-host observation; no search excerpt is promoted to evidence.
